assets.name: Character puppet
assets.description: The stick figure itself: head, torso, arms, legs and hands. Every person on screen is this puppet with a pose, a face and optional skin, hair and costume.
assets.use: <Character x groundY head pose face turn facing identity outfit prop />. A smaller head makes a child.

assets.name: Back view
assets.description: A character seen from behind: no face, hair and headwear covering the back of the head, a cape hanging over the body. For the near person in an over-the-shoulder shot, or someone walking away.
assets.use: <Character back ... /> with any costume, hair or age

assets.name: Stand
assets.description: Standing still with the arms hanging at the sides. The default pose.

assets.name: Wave
assets.description: One arm raised in a wave, the other at the side.

assets.name: Point
assets.description: One arm stretched out with a pointing finger, leaning slightly forward.

assets.name: Shrug
assets.description: Both forearms raised to the sides and the head tilted, as in "I do not know".

assets.name: Hands up
assets.description: Both arms raised above the head, knees a little bent.

assets.name: Hold object
assets.description: One arm reaching out with a closed fist around an upright object such as a staff, the other arm relaxed.

assets.name: Hands over mouth
assets.description: Both hands pressed over the mouth in shock.

assets.name: Sit
assets.description: Sitting on a seat as high as the shins: thighs level, shins down, hands on the lap. Needs a seat, throne, rock or ledge under it.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(sit)} with a seat body.shin high under the hip; best three-quarter or profile

assets.name: Kneel
assets.description: Down on one knee with the other foot planted, a hand on the raised knee and the head bowed.

assets.name: Lie down
assets.description: Lying on the ground on one side with the head down, one arm along the body and one reaching forward.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lie)} with turn={0}; the figure is about three heads long

assets.name: Cross arms
assets.description: Standing with both arms folded across the chest.

assets.name: Look up
assets.description: Standing with the head tipped back to look at something above.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lookUp)} with lookAt on the thing above

assets.name: Look down
assets.description: Standing with the head bowed to look at something below.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(lookDown)} with lookAt on the thing below

assets.name: Cower
assets.description: Crouched and hunched with both arms raised over the head.

assets.name: Hug
assets.description: Leaning in with both arms wrapped around someone standing close in front. Two characters in this pose, facing each other, make a hug.
assets.use: pose={resolvePose(hug)} on two characters about 1.2 head-widths apart, facing each other

assets.name: Walk
assets.description: A walking cycle with planted feet and swinging arms. The character moves forward as time passes.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}; the camera follows w.pose.rootX

assets.name: Proud walk
assets.description: A slow strut: chest out, chin up, high steps and a wide arm swing.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.proud); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Tired walk
assets.description: A slow trudge: short steps that barely leave the ground, bent forward with the head down and the arms hanging.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.tired); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Sneaky walk
assets.description: Creeping on high careful steps: crouched, head pushed forward, hands held up in front.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.sneaky); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Happy walk
assets.description: A quick bouncy walk with a big arm swing and the head up.
assets.use: const w = walkAt(frame / fps, WALKS.happy); pose={w.pose} with turn={1}

assets.name: Cheer
assets.description: Arms thrown up in a V and pumping, the body bouncing on bent knees. Loops.
assets.use: pose={cheerAt(frame / fps)} with the laughing or happy face

assets.name: Cry
assets.description: The face in both hands with the head bowed, shoulders shaking in bursts of sobs. Loops.
assets.use: pose={cryAt(frame / fps)} with the wailing or sad face

assets.name: Run
assets.description: A flat-out run: both feet off the ground between steps, the body thrown forward, elbows pumping. Loops.
assets.use: const r = walkAt(frame / fps, GAITS.run); pose={r.pose} with turn={1}; the body moves forward by r.pose.rootX

assets.name: Carry a load
assets.description: Walking with a load held in both arms in front of the body, leaning back against the weight. Loops.
assets.use: pose={walkAt(frame / fps, GAITS.carry).pose} and draw the load at the two hands with the prop slot

assets.name: Push
assets.description: Pushing something heavy: the body leans hard into both arms and drives forward with short steps. Loops.
assets.use: pose={walkAt(frame / fps, GAITS.push).pose}; move the pushed thing with the body

assets.name: Pull
assets.description: Pulling on a rope or handle held in both fists, leaning back and stepping backward. Loops.
assets.use: pose={walkAt(-frame / fps, GAITS.pull).pose} (time runs backward, so the feet step backward)

assets.name: Jump
assets.description: A jump: crouch with the arms back, spring up with the arms high, tuck the legs, land on bent knees and stand. Takes 1.1 seconds.
assets.use: pose={jumpAt(seconds, height, distance)} with seconds counted from the start of the jump

assets.name: Fall forward
assets.description: Falling flat on the face, as after a trip: toppling forward with the arms out, hitting the ground, one bounce, lying still.
assets.use: pose={fallAt(seconds)}; it ends lying down and stays there

assets.name: Fall backward
assets.description: Knocked flat on the back: going over backward with the arms flailing, landing, one bounce, lying still with a knee up.
assets.use: pose={fallBackAt(seconds)}; follow a recoil with it for a knock-down

assets.name: Punch
assets.description: A punch: the fist cocks back, the body steps in and the arm shoots straight out, holds a beat and returns. The hit lands 0.22 seconds in.
assets.use: pose={punchAt(seconds)}; put an Impact flash at the fist at PUNCH.hit and start the other person recoilAt there

assets.name: Swing a held thing
assets.description: Swinging something held in the front hand: up and back over the shoulder, down hard in front with a step, follow through, back to upright.
assets.use: pose={swingAt(seconds)} with a prop in the front hand; the hit lands at SWING.hit

assets.name: Recoil from a hit
assets.description: Being hit from the front: the head snaps back, the body buckles away, two stumbling steps backward, then upright again.
assets.use: pose={recoilAt(seconds)} with seconds counted from the moment the blow lands; add a head squash on the first frames

assets.name: Float
assets.description: Hanging in the air with no gravity: the body bobs slowly, arms and legs drifting loose.

assets.name: Blinks and breathing
assets.description: Small movement while a character holds a pose: blinks every few seconds, breathing, a slight head bob and a slow shift of weight from leg to leg.
assets.use: pose={withLife(pose, frame, fps, seed)} blink={blinkAt(frame, fps, seed)}

assets.name: Talking mouth
assets.description: The mouth forms the spoken words of one voice line with five shapes: closed, half, open, wide (ee) and round (oo).
assets.use: talk={talkAt(frame, fps, wordsOfTheLine)} where the words are the voice track words of that line

assets.name: Moves one after another
assets.description: Plays actions in turn, such as sneak, then run, then jump: each starts where the last one left the body, with a short blend at each change so nothing pops.
assets.use: pose={chainAt(seconds, [{ from: 0, at: sneak }, { from: 1.3, at: run }, { from: 3.1, at: jumpAt }])}; pose.rootX is how far the character has travelled

assets.name: Pose changes with wind-up and settle
assets.description: Moving from one pose to the next: a short wind-up the other way before a big move, a quick snap, a small overshoot and a dip of the hips, then the hold.
assets.use: pose={poseAt(frame, [{ frame: 0, pose: stand }, { frame: 40, pose: wave }])}

assets.name: Capes, hair and held things swing
assets.description: Loose things lag behind the body: a cape or cloak hem and long hair trail a walk and swing on past when the body stops, and the top of a held staff tips back as the arm moves.
assets.use: sway={swayOf((f) => poseOfThisCharacterAt(f), frame, fps)} with the same function the scene uses for the pose

assets.name: Eye darts
assets.description: Small quick glances to the side every second or two, so the eyes are never frozen during a hold.

assets.name: Smooth head turn
assets.description: Turning to look the other way or toward a speaker: the head and body swing through the front view over a few frames instead of flipping.
assets.use: const t = turnAt(frame, [{ frame: 0, facing: "right", turn: 0.5 }, { frame: 60, facing: "left", turn: 0.5 }]); facing={t.facing} turn={t.turn}

assets.name: Neutral
assets.description: A calm, plain face. The default.

assets.name: Happy
assets.description: A smile with arched brows and lifted cheeks.

assets.name: Laughing
assets.description: Eyes closed in arcs and a wide open laughing mouth.

assets.name: Sad
assets.description: Raised inner brows, drooping lids, low pupils and a frown.

assets.name: Angry
assets.description: Hooked V brows, heavy shaded lids and a wide frown with curled corners.

assets.name: Shouting
assets.description: Angry brows with an open mouth showing teeth.

assets.name: Afraid
assets.description: The frightened face measured from Reference B: lower lids pushed up, pupils resting on them, worry creases and a wide gritted grimace. The face tips down toward where the character looks.

assets.name: Surprised
assets.description: High light brows, very wide eyes and a small round mouth.

assets.name: Determined
assets.description: Low straight brows, narrowed eyes and a firm mouth.

assets.name: Thinking
assets.description: One brow raised, pupils up and to the side, small sideways mouth.

assets.name: Smug
assets.description: One brow raised, half-closed lids and a one-sided smirk.

assets.name: Exhausted
assets.description: Drooping brows, heavy lids with a crease under each eye and a slack open mouth.

assets.name: Wailing
assets.description: Eyes squeezed shut with stress creases and a wide crying mouth with tongue.

assets.name: Horrified
assets.description: Very wide eyes with tiny pupils, light raised brows, a small round mouth and chin strokes.

assets.name: Asleep
assets.description: Eyes gently closed, brows at rest and a small mouth a little open with breath.

assets.name: Stern eyes
assets.description: Black almond eyes under heavy brows, from the king in Reference A. For cold, commanding or menacing characters.

assets.name: Resting hand
assets.description: A rounded mitten with a small thumb bump, for hands that hang, rest or wave.
assets.use: hand: 'mitten' in a pose arm (the default)

assets.name: Gripping hand
assets.description: A closed fist around a handle: fingers as fat bands that hide the handle, thumb across the top.
assets.use: hand: 'grip', gripAxis: -90 in a pose arm

assets.name: Pointing hand
assets.description: A fist with the index finger extended.

assets.name: Skin tone 1
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 1 of 8, very light, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 2
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 2 of 8, light, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 3
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 3 of 8, light tan, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 4
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 4 of 8, tan, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 5
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 5 of 8, medium brown, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Skin tone 6
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 6 of 8, brown, with its one shadow tone and a light rim so the face reads on dark backgrounds.

assets.name: Skin tone 7
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 7 of 8, dark brown, with its one shadow tone and a light rim so the face reads on dark backgrounds.

assets.name: Skin tone 8
assets.description: Identity mode skin tone 8 of 8, very dark, with its one shadow tone and a light rim so the face reads on dark backgrounds.

assets.name: Bald
assets.description: No hair at all.

assets.name: Short crop
assets.description: Short hair close to the head.

assets.name: Fade
assets.description: Short on top with faded sides.

assets.name: Afro
assets.description: A big round afro.

assets.name: Locs
assets.description: Long locs hanging beside the face.

assets.name: Braids
assets.description: Long braids hanging beside the face.

assets.name: Straight bob
assets.description: Straight hair cut at the jaw.

assets.name: Bun
assets.description: Hair tied in a bun on top of the head.

assets.name: Ponytail
assets.description: Hair tied back in a ponytail.

assets.name: Head wrap
assets.description: A cloth wrap covering the hair, in an accent color.

assets.name: Long hair
assets.description: Long hair falling down the back, behind the shoulders.

assets.name: Black hair
assets.description: Black hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Dark brown hair
assets.description: Dark brown hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Brown hair
assets.description: Brown hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Auburn hair
assets.description: Auburn hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Blond hair
assets.description: Blond hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Gray hair
assets.description: Gray hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: White hair
assets.description: White hair, with its one shadow tone.

assets.name: Beard
assets.description: A full beard along the jaw, in the hair color.

assets.name: Moustache
assets.description: A moustache above the mouth, in the hair color.

assets.name: Tank top
assets.description: A sleeveless top with narrow straps, as on the frightened figure in Reference B. Arms stay stick lines.

assets.name: Shirt
assets.description: A plain buttoned shirt with long or short sleeves, in any cloth color.

assets.name: Trousers
assets.description: Long trousers with legs hanging from the hips, as the navy jeans in Reference B.

assets.name: Skirt
assets.description: A knee-length skirt flaring from the waist, with stick legs below.

assets.name: Dress
assets.description: A knee-length dress: a fitted top that flares from the waist.

assets.name: Robe
assets.description: A long robe from the shoulders to the ankles with wide sleeves and a cord at the waist.

assets.name: Cloak
assets.description: A cloak down the back with a drape over each shoulder, worn over other clothes. The hood lies behind the neck.

assets.name: Hood
assets.description: The cloak with its hood pulled up, framing the face.

assets.name: Brimmed hat
assets.description: A plain hat with a wide flat brim, like a straw hat. It sits just above the brows.

assets.name: Sneakers
assets.description: Low chunky shoes with a round toe cap, a sole stripe and laces, as in Reference B.

assets.name: Boots
assets.description: Chunky ankle boots in any cloth color.

assets.name: T-shirt
assets.description: A plain round-necked T-shirt with short sleeves.

assets.name: Hoodie
assets.description: A loose hooded top with a pouch pocket, two cords and the hood lying round the neck.

assets.name: Jacket
assets.description: An open jacket with lapels over a plain top of another color.

assets.name: Lab coat
assets.description: A long open white coat to the thighs with pockets, over a plain top.

assets.name: Glasses
assets.description: A pair of round glasses that sit on the eyes wherever the head is turned.

assets.name: Ruler
assets.description: A full royal costume: three-point gold crown, crimson cape with a high collar, steel breastplate, sleeves and boots with gold trim, white gloves. An original design in the spirit of Reference A.

assets.name: Soldier
assets.description: A foot soldier in full costume: a pointed steel helmet with a gold band over a mail coif, a crimson tabard with a gold belt, steel shoulder plates, mail sleeves and leggings, boots. An original design.

assets.name: Queen
assets.description: A queen or noblewoman in full costume: a navy gown to the ground with gold belt and hem, short puffed sleeves, white gloves and a low gold crown of three arches with pearls. An original design.

assets.name: Farmer
assets.description: A farmer or villager: green short-sleeved shirt, tan trousers, brown leather boots and a straw hat. Built from the tier 1 garments.

assets.name: Scientist
assets.description: A white lab coat over a pale blue top, dark trousers, brown shoes and glasses. The one who explains in the science videos.

assets.name: Astronaut
assets.description: A bulky white space suit with a chest panel, a pack on the back, gloves and boots, and a clear round helmet with the head inside.

assets.name: Child
assets.description: A child: a smaller body under a full-size head. Use a smaller head size than the adults in the shot as well.
assets.use: age="child" on the Character, with head about 0.86 of an adult's

assets.name: Adult
assets.description: An adult: the standard proportions. This is the default.

assets.name: Elder
assets.description: An elder: a stooped back and a few permanent creases on the face. Add gray or white hair and a beard for the rest.
assets.use: age="elder" on the Character, with gray or white hair

assets.name: Scepter
assets.description: A gold scepter with a crimson orb, held upright in a gripping hand.
assets.use: prop={(hands, info) => <Scepter frame={hands.front} uid={info.uid} shadowSide={info.shadowSide} />} with the hold-object pose

assets.name: A prop in a hand, or standing in the scene
assets.description: How every prop is put into a picture: in a hand so it turns with it, stays upright or hangs and swings; or standing on the ground or a table at the size of the characters.
assets.use: prop={(hands, info) => <InHand frame={hands.front} how="grip|upright|hang" sway={info.sway}><Sword uid={info.uid} shadowSide={info.shadowSide} /></InHand>}; in the scene: <Placed x={px} y={groundPx} head={headPx}>...</Placed>

assets.name: Sword
assets.description: A sword with a bright blade, a gold cross-guard and a brown grip. A story prop: raised, pointed, never shown wounding anyone.
assets.use: <InHand frame={hands.front}><Sword uid shadowSide /></InHand> with a gripping hand; swingAt swings it

assets.name: Shield
assets.description: A shield with a gold rim and boss on a field of one bright color. Covers the hand and forearm that carry it.
assets.use: <InHand frame={hands.back} how="upright"><Shield uid shadowSide paint="crimson" /></InHand> on a hand that is not gripping

assets.name: Coin
assets.description: A big gold coin with a star stamped on it. For money, tax, payment, treasure and bribes.
assets.use: <InHand frame={hands.front} how="upright" reach={0.24}><Coin uid shadowSide /></InHand> to hold it up; several on a table with Placed

assets.name: Bag
assets.description: A cloth bag tied at the neck, held by its gathered neck so cloth shows above the fist and the bag hangs below, or standing on the ground: a sack of coins, grain or loot.
assets.use: <InHand frame={hands.front} how="hang" sway={info.sway}><Bag uid shadowSide /></InHand> with a gripping hand

assets.name: Book
assets.description: A closed book with a bright cover and a gold mark. For study, law, scripture, records and stories.

assets.name: Open book
assets.description: An open book with two cream pages and lines of writing, held up to read or lying on a table.
assets.use: <Book uid shadowSide open /> a little above the hands of someone reading

assets.name: Lantern
assets.description: A lantern with a glowing glass and a flame, hanging from the hand or standing on a table, with a soft pool of light that flickers.
assets.use: <InHand frame={hands.front} how="hang" sway={info.sway}><Lantern uid shadowSide t={frame / fps} /></InHand>

assets.name: Cup
assets.description: A plain mug with a handle, in one bright color. For homes, taverns, tea and water.
assets.use: <InHand frame={hands.front} how="upright"><Cup uid shadowSide /></InHand> with a gripping hand; on a table CUP_REST.mug above the top

assets.name: Goblet
assets.description: A gold cup on a stem. For kings, feasts, toasts and poison plots.
assets.use: <Cup uid shadowSide kind="goblet" /> in a gripping hand, or on a table CUP_REST.goblet above the top

assets.name: Door
assets.description: A wooden door in its frame with iron bands and a gold ring, which swings open to show a dark room behind.
assets.use: <Placed x y={groundPx} head><Door uid shadowSide open={0 to 1} /></Placed>; draw a character after it to stand them in the doorway

assets.name: Chair
assets.description: A plain wooden chair seen from the side. A character in the sit pose at the same place sits on it.
assets.use: <Placed x={sitterX} y={groundPx} head><Chair uid shadowSide /></Placed> drawn before the sitter; flip on Placed faces it left

assets.name: Throne
assets.description: A tall gold throne with a crimson cushion and an armrest, seen from the side. For a ruler holding court.
assets.use: <Placed x={sitterX} y={groundPx} head><Chair uid shadowSide kind="throne" /></Placed> drawn before the ruler, who uses the sit pose

assets.name: Table
assets.description: A wooden table seen from the side, with room on top for cups, books, coins and lanterns.
assets.use: <Placed x y={groundPx} head><Table uid shadowSide width={2.4} /></Placed>; things stand on it at y = -TABLE.top

assets.name: Sun
assets.description: A gold ball in a ring of orange flares that breathe, with a soft glow round it.
assets.use: <Sun uid shadowSide={1} r={1.5} t={seconds} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "sun", x: 0.7, y: 5 }]

assets.name: Full Moon
assets.description: The whole round Moon with its craters: warm in a night sky, or gray as it looks from space.
assets.use: <FullMoon uid shadowSide={1} r={1.1} paint="gray" />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "full-moon", x: 0.7, y: 5 }]

assets.name: Earth
assets.description: The Earth from space: blue ocean, green land that slowly turns, white caps and cloud, a thin haze of air.
assets.use: <Earth uid shadowSide={1} r={1.6} t={seconds} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "earth", x: 0.5, y: 4, size: 1.5 }]

assets.name: Planet
assets.description: A planet as a ball in any color of the style, with darker patches. Orange-red by default, like Mars.
assets.use: <Planet uid shadowSide={1} r={1.2} paint="orange" />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "planet", x: 0.6, y: 4 }]

assets.name: Ringed planet
assets.description: A banded tan planet with a wide ring that passes behind it and in front, like Saturn.
assets.use: <Planet uid shadowSide={1} paint="tan" bands ring="cream" />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "planet-ringed", x: 0.6, y: 4 }]

assets.name: Gas giant
assets.description: A big brown planet with bands of weather and one storm spot, like Jupiter.
assets.use: <Planet uid shadowSide={1} paint="brown" bands />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "planet-giant", x: 0.6, y: 4 }]

assets.name: Ice planet
assets.description: A pale blue planet, like Uranus or Neptune, or a frozen world.
assets.use: <Planet uid shadowSide={1} paint="glint" />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "planet-ice", x: 0.6, y: 4 }]

assets.name: Asteroid
assets.description: A lump of brown rock with a long tail of fire streaming behind it. Without the fire it is a rock drifting in space.
assets.use: <Asteroid uid shadowSide={1} r={0.7} t={seconds} heading={145} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "asteroid", x: 0.7, y: 6 }]

assets.name: Black hole
assets.description: A ball of nothing with a thin ring of light at its edge and a wide disc of glowing dust that turns round it.
assets.use: <BlackHole uid shadowSide={1} r={1.2} t={seconds} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "black-hole", x: 0.5, y: 4 }]

assets.name: Rocket
assets.description: A white rocket with a red nose and fins, a round window and a dark nozzle. It stands on its fins, or flies with fire pouring from its engine.
assets.use: <Rocket uid shadowSide={1} flame={1} t={seconds} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "rocket", x: 0.6 }] or "rocket-flying"

assets.name: Rocket in flight
assets.description: The rocket up in the air, tilted on its way, with fire pouring from its engine.
assets.use: in a shot: props: [{ prop: "rocket-flying", x: 0.6, y: 4 }]

assets.name: Flying sweat drops
assets.description: Light blue drops that fly out from the head in arcs and fade, on a loop. For fear, panic and strain.

assets.name: Resting sweat drop
assets.description: One light blue drop sitting on the head. For worry, effort and tiredness.

assets.name: Streams of tears
assets.description: Light blue streams running from both eyes down the cheeks and off the jaw, with drops flying off. For bawling, with the wailing face.
assets.use: headEffects={<TearStreams turn={turn} t={frame / fps} />} with the same turn as the character

assets.name: Tear drops
assets.description: Single tears that well up at each eye, roll down the cheek and fall. For quiet crying, with the sad face.
assets.use: headEffects={<TearDrops turn={turn} t={frame / fps} />} with the same turn as the character

assets.name: Anger mark
assets.description: A red cross-shaped vein mark that throbs near the top of the head. For anger and rage.
assets.use: headEffects={<AngerMark t={frame / fps} />} with the angry or shouting face

assets.name: Dizzy stars
assets.description: Small gold stars circling the top of the head. For someone dazed, knocked silly or confused after a hit or a fall.
assets.use: headEffects={<DizzyStars t={frame / fps} />} after a recoil or a fall

assets.name: Exclamation mark
assets.description: A bold outlined ! that pops in over the head. For surprise, alarm or a sudden idea.

assets.name: Question mark
assets.description: A bold outlined ? that pops in over the head. For puzzlement, doubt or thinking.

assets.name: Three dots
assets.description: Three bold outlined dots that pop in one after another over the head. For a stunned or awkward silence.

assets.name: Impact flash
assets.description: A brief white starburst with a black outline that bursts out and vanishes. For a blow, a crash or a hard landing; it covers the point of contact.
assets.use: <Impact x={px} y={px} head={headPx} t={secondsSinceTheHit} /> in the scene, above the characters

assets.name: Motion lines
assets.description: Short black lines trailing something that moves fast: a runner, a fist, a thrown thing.
assets.use: <MotionLines x={px} y={px} head={headPx} direction={0} frame={frame} /> just behind the moving thing; direction is the way it travels

assets.name: Explosion
assets.description: A white flash, a ball of fire that bursts out and rolls up into gray smoke, and bits of rock thrown clear. Nobody is shown hurt by it.
assets.use: <Explosion t={secondsSinceItWentOff} size={2} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "explosion", x: 0.6, y: 1.5 }]

assets.name: Fire
assets.description: A fire burning on the ground: three tongues of flame that lick and sway, orange outside and gold within, with smoke if wanted.
assets.use: <Fire t={seconds} size={1.4} smoke />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "fire", x: 0.6 }]

assets.name: Smoke
assets.description: Gray puffs that rise from the ground one after another, growing and thinning as they go.
assets.use: <Smoke t={seconds} size={1} />; in a shot: props: [{ prop: "smoke", x: 0.6 }]

assets.name: Simple background
assets.description: Flat color fields, a flat ground band and black silhouettes, from Reference B. For comedy, everyday scenes and fast explainers.
assets.use: <Background spec={backgroundSpec('simple', palette, seed, overrides)} width height frame fps />

assets.name: Atmospheric background
assets.description: A soft painted sky with layered clouds, light rays, stars, haze and hills, from Reference A. For drama, history, danger and emotional peaks.
assets.use: <Background spec={backgroundSpec('atmospheric', palette, seed, overrides)} width height frame fps />

assets.name: Night street
assets.description: A village street after dark: houses with lit windows, a street lamp and the moon over a paved road.
assets.use: <Background spec={placeSpec('night-street', seed)} width height frame fps />; stay in one place for a whole scene

assets.name: Day street
assets.description: A village street by day: houses and a tree along a paved road under a clear sky.
assets.use: <Background spec={placeSpec('day-street', seed)} width height frame fps />; stay in one place for a whole scene

assets.name: Field
assets.description: Open farmland by day: rolling hills, a fence, a tree and long grass.
assets.use: <Background spec={placeSpec('field', seed)} width height frame fps />; stay in one place for a whole scene

assets.name: Forest
assets.description: Among trees by day: pines and round trees close together, with dark trunks framing the picture.
assets.use: <Background spec={placeSpec('forest', seed)} width height frame fps />; stay in one place for a whole scene

assets.name: Castle
assets.description: A castle with towers and battlements on its hill under a stormy night sky, with light through the clouds.
assets.use: <Background spec={placeSpec('castle', seed)} width height frame fps />; stay in one place for a whole scene

assets.name: Throne room
assets.description: The great hall of a castle: stone columns, hanging banners and tall arched windows with pale light.
assets.use: <Background spec={placeSpec('throne-room', seed)} width height frame fps />; stay in one place for a whole scene

assets.name: Home interior
assets.description: A room in a house: a warm wall, a window with light coming in, a shelf of jars and books, a wooden floor.
assets.use: <Background spec={placeSpec('home-interior', seed)} width height frame fps />; stay in one place for a whole scene

assets.name: Outer space
assets.description: A near-black sky full of stars, with no ground. People in it float.
assets.use: placeSpec('space', seed); in a scene: place "space" with palette "deep-space"

assets.name: Above the Earth
assets.description: In space above the Earth: the planet large below, the Sun small and far, stars all round.
assets.use: placeSpec('earth-orbit', seed); in a scene: place "earth-orbit" with palette "deep-space"

assets.name: On the Moon
assets.description: Gray dust and craters under a black starry sky, with the Earth hanging in it. Works for any bare rocky world.
assets.use: placeSpec('moon-surface', seed); in a scene: place "moon-surface" with palette "moon-dust"

assets.name: City street
assets.description: A modern city street: tall blocks with rows of windows and a street lamp. By night some windows are lit.
assets.use: placeSpec('city', seed); in a scene: place "city" with palette "clear-day", or "dusk-violet" for night

assets.name: Living room
assets.description: A modern living room: a sofa on a rug, a floor lamp, a television, a picture on the wall, a plant.
assets.use: placeSpec('living-room', seed); in a scene: place "living-room" with palette "warm-interior"

assets.name: Science lab
assets.description: A science lab: a bench with a flask, test tubes and a microscope, shelves of jars, a board with a chart.
assets.use: placeSpec('lab', seed); in a scene: place "lab" with palette "cold-dawn"

assets.name: Storm slate
assets.description: Dark blue-gray night colors, from Reference A.

assets.name: Dusk violet
assets.description: Muted violet night colors, from Reference B.

assets.name: Clear day
assets.description: Blue sky and green ground for daytime.

assets.name: Warm interior
assets.description: Warm tan and brown colors for indoor scenes.

assets.name: Danger
assets.description: Dark reds for threat, fire and battle.

assets.name: Cold dawn
assets.description: Pale blue-gray and cream for early morning.

assets.name: Deep space
assets.description: A near-black blue sky for outer space.

assets.name: Moon dust
assets.description: The deep space sky over pale gray ground, for the Moon and other bare worlds.

assets.name: Crescent moon
assets.description: A flat pale yellow crescent moon with no outline. It stays put while other layers slide.
assets.use: moon: { x, y, r } in the background spec; null hides it

assets.name: Stars
assets.description: A few small white dots of varied size that twinkle.

assets.name: Clouds
assets.description: Soft layered clouds that drift slowly, lighter on the edge facing the light.
assets.use: clouds: <count> in an atmospheric background spec

assets.name: Light rays
assets.description: Two to four pale translucent beams from the light source, pulsing gently.
assets.use: rays: true in an atmospheric background spec

assets.name: Hills
assets.description: Soft distant hills on the horizon, lighter the farther away.
assets.use: hills: true in the background spec

assets.name: Grass tufts
assets.description: Small dark tufts of grass on the ground.

assets.name: Bush
assets.description: A black bush with white curl details, like the one in Reference B.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'bush', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Tree
assets.description: A round-topped tree silhouette.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'tree', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Rock
assets.description: A dark rock or boulder silhouette.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'rock', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Buildings
assets.description: A row of plain building silhouettes.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'buildings', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: House
assets.description: A house with a pitched roof, a chimney, a door and two windows that glow at night.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'house', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Castle
assets.description: A castle keep between two towers, with battlements, a gate and a lit window.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'castle', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Pine
assets.description: A pointed pine in three tiers, for forests and mountains.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'pine', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Lamp post
assets.description: A street lamp on a tall post, with a pool of light round it at night.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'lamp-post', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Fence
assets.description: A run of pointed fence posts with two rails.
assets.use: silhouettes: [{ kind: 'fence', x, size, layer: 'near' | 'mid' }] in the background spec

assets.name: Tower block
assets.description: A modern block of flats or offices: a flat-roofed slab with rows of windows, lit at night.

assets.name: Gold
assets.description: The gold accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Crimson
assets.description: The crimson accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Orange
assets.description: The orange accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Steel
assets.description: The steel accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Denim
assets.description: The denim accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Glint
assets.description: The glint accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Forest
assets.description: The forest accent color with its shadow tone, for costumes and props.

assets.name: Brown
assets.description: The brown cloth color with its shadow tone: leather, wool and wood for ordinary people.
assets.use: cloth: 'brown' in clothes data, or const [fill, shadow] = accent('brown')

assets.name: Tan
assets.description: The tan cloth color with its shadow tone: sacking, khaki and sand for ordinary people.
assets.use: cloth: 'tan' in clothes data, or const [fill, shadow] = accent('tan')

assets.name: Cream
assets.description: The cream cloth color with its shadow tone: undyed linen and wool, softer than white.
assets.use: cloth: 'cream' in clothes data, or const [fill, shadow] = accent('cream')

assets.name: Ocean blue
assets.description: A clear mid blue with its shadow tone: the sea on the Earth seen from space.

assets.name: Slow push-in
assets.description: The camera moves slowly closer to a focus point over a shot. For emotional lines.
assets.use: <PushIn frame durationInFrames strength={0.08} focus={{ x, y }}>...</PushIn>

assets.name: Fast push-in
assets.description: The camera jumps closer to a focus point in a few frames and holds. For a shock, a reveal or the instant of a hit.
assets.use: <PunchIn frame={frame} at={hitFrame} strength={0.18} focus={{ x, y }}>...</PunchIn>

assets.name: Camera shake
assets.description: The whole picture jolts and settles in about a third of a second. For an impact: a blow, a crash, a landing, thunder.
assets.use: <Shake frame={frame} fps={fps} at={hitFrame} width={width} height={height}>...</Shake>; at can be a list of frames

assets.name: Pan
assets.description: The camera slides sideways or up and down across a scene bigger than the frame. Over a few frames it is a whip pan, kept for the change between scenes.
assets.use: <Pan frame={frame} from={startFrame} to={endFrame} dx={px}>...</Pan>; the scene must be drawn wider than the frame

assets.name: Following camera
assets.description: The camera rides along with a character that travels a long way, such as a runner in a chase. The background is set to endless, so the hills, trees and grass repeat and never run out.
assets.use: <Background spec={spec} cameraX={travelledPx} endless ... /> where travelledPx is pose.rootX * head; draw the followed character at a fixed screen x and everyone else at their world x minus travelledPx

assets.name: Quick fade between scenes
assets.description: The picture dips to dark and comes back on the next scene. For a change of place or time; shots inside one scene change with a plain cut.
assets.use: <Fade frame={frame} at={frameTheSceneChanges} width={width} height={height} /> drawn over everything

assets.name: Wide shot
assets.description: Whole figures with their surroundings. The layout every scene starts from: it shows where everyone is.
assets.use: <Framed shot="wide" focus={focusBetween(focusOn(a, poseA), focusOn(b, poseB))} width height>scene</Framed>

assets.name: Medium shot
assets.description: A person from the head to about the hips, or two people together. The everyday shot for talk and action.
assets.use: <Framed shot="medium" focus={focusOn(person, pose)} width height>the same wide scene</Framed>

assets.name: Close-up
assets.description: One face filling about two fifths of the frame. For the feeling on a face at an important moment.
assets.use: <Framed shot="close-up" focus={focusOn(person, pose)} width height>the same wide scene</Framed>

assets.name: Over the shoulder
assets.description: The person being looked at, past the back of the head and shoulder of the one looking. For a conversation or showing something to someone.
assets.use: <Framed shot="over-shoulder" focus={focusOn(far, pose)} ...>scene</Framed> then <Character {...shoulderPlacement(size)} back ... /> on top

assets.name: Captions
assets.description: White Fredoka captions with a black outline in the bottom quarter, two short lines at a time, the emphasized word in gold.

assets.name: Title card
assets.description: A ribbon banner across the upper part of the frame with the title in white and an optional smaller line under it. Pops in with a small bounce. For the name of a video or a chapter.
assets.use: <TitleCard title="The Golden Coin" subtitle="A folktale" width height frame={framesSinceItAppeared} paint="crimson" />

assets.name: Label
assets.description: A small outlined box with dark text at the top of the frame, for a place, a date, a time or a name.
assets.use: <Label text="That evening" at="top-left" width height frame={framesSinceItAppeared} />

assets.name: Page mark
assets.description: The page's name, small and see-through, in one corner of every frame. A bottom corner sits just above the caption band. Drawn only when the brand file has a watermark.
assets.use: <Watermark mark={{ text: "Page name", corner: "top-right", opacity: 0.75 }} width height />

assets.name: Closing card
assets.description: The card after the last shot: the page's line on a ribbon over a quiet flat field, with an optional smaller line under it. Added by the output step when the brand file has a closing card.
assets.use: <ClosingCard text="Thanks for watching" subtext="A new story every week" width height frame={framesSinceItBegan} />

assets.name: Big number
assets.description: The one figure a shot is about, large in gold with a black outline, and an optional short line under it in a cream box.
assets.use: overlay: { kind: "number", text: "1,670 km/h", caption: "how fast the ground moves" }

assets.name: Arrow with a label
assets.description: A cream box with a few words and a bold arrow from it to the thing it names.
assets.use: overlay: { kind: "pointer", text: "The Moon", at: { x: 0.3, y: 0.2 }, to: { x: 0.6, y: 0.35 } }

assets.name: Orbit diagram
assets.description: One thing in the middle, a tilted dashed ring round it, and a smaller thing going round on the ring. For reading, not to scale.

assets.name: Tense music
assets.description: Danger close by: a low pulse, trembling strings and a waiting drum. For threats, chases about to start, a secret about to come out.

assets.name: Sorrowful music
assets.description: Loss and regret: a slow piano under a cello line. For a death, a parting, a defeat.

assets.name: Hopeful music
assets.description: Things may turn out well: rising piano, warm strings and a flute. For a new start, a plan forming, help arriving.

assets.name: Triumphant music
assets.description: A win: brass, a marching drum and a trumpet tune. For a victory, a crowning, a goal reached.

assets.name: Reflective music
assets.description: Thinking it over: soft electric piano and a few vibraphone notes. For a lesson, a memory, the quiet after an event.

assets.name: Curious music
assets.description: Something odd to find out: plucked strings and a marimba that pokes about. For a question, a mystery, an opening hook.

assets.name: Upbeat music
assets.description: Good news and energy: strummed guitar, bass, drums and a bright piano tune. For lists, facts, a happy ending.

assets.name: Calm music
assets.description: Peace and rest: a harp, a soft pad and a little flute. For a quiet scene, nature, sleep, walking home.

assets.name: Comic music
assets.description: Something silly: an oom-pah tuba and a bassoon with a spring in its step. For a fool, a mishap, a joke.

assets.name: Whoosh
assets.description: A fast move through the air. For a sword swing, a dash, a thrown thing, a quick camera move.

assets.name: Pop
assets.description: A small bright pop. For something appearing, a title or label landing, a bubble.

assets.name: Thud
assets.description: A heavy dull landing. For a fall, a dropped load, a door closing, a body hitting the ground.

assets.name: Click
assets.description: A tiny tick. For a latch, a switch, a lock, a cut on the beat.

assets.name: Footsteps
assets.description: Steps on a hard floor, two a second, for as long as the walk lasts.

assets.name: Wind
assets.description: Open-air wind with soft gusts, running under a whole shot. For a storm sky, a hilltop, an empty street at night.

assets.name: Crowd murmur
assets.description: A room or street full of people talking with no words to make out, running under a whole shot. For a market, a court, a hall.

assets.name: Creak
assets.description: Wood under strain. For a door opening slowly, a floorboard, a chair, a ship.

assets.name: Blip
assets.description: A drop: a quick rising plip. For a sweat drop, a tear, a small idea, a tiny surprise.

assets.name: Hit
assets.description: A cartoon blow landing, with no crunch. For a punch, a swing that connects, a bump.

assets.name: Ding
assets.description: A coin or a small bell ringing out. For money, a prize, a good idea, a right answer.
